# Vendored libraries

Pinned copies served by Optimux itself, so no CDN can change the code the page runs
(the Content Security Policy only allows scripts from this server). The version is in
each file name. To update one, download the new version from npm, replace the file,
update the `<script>`/`<link>` in `index.html`, and run the tests.

| File | Library | License |
|---|---|---|
| `vue-3.5.13.global.prod.js` | [Vue](https://vuejs.org/) 3.5.13 (global build with the template compiler) | MIT |
| `marked-15.0.12.umd.js` | [marked](https://marked.js.org/) 15.0.12 | MIT |
| `purify-3.2.6.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) 3.2.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight-11.9.0.min.js`, `highlight-11.9.0-github-dark.min.css` | [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `qrcode-generator-1.4.4.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) 1.4.4 | MIT |

`web/app.css` is generated by [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) 3.4.17 with
`@tailwindcss/typography` 0.5.16 (both MIT) from `scripts/build-css.sh`.
